title: Chapter 95: Transporting Supplies
content:
Chapter 95: Transporting Supplies

The city used as a camp by the army of the evil god camp has a huge amount of stored supplies.

These supplies are the logistical supplies of hundreds of thousands of troops in the evil god camp. If the Tengu clan wants to waste time, these supplies are the confidence they use to keep fighting with the Tengu clan.

Now these supplies have become Wu Qing's spoils of war. As long as they are transported back, Daxia Territory will become one of the richest territories in this area.

As the saying goes, it is safe to put it in the bag. Wu Qing didn't want to delay for a moment and asked the Queen of Insects to arrange the transportation of supplies immediately.

More than 50,000 parasites who had just recovered began to move, skillfully reloading various materials that they had originally transported and managed onto the backs of giant transport lizards.

They took a supply bag themselves, and their backs were also full of supplies, and they started to hurry with the giant transport lizard.

The movement of the parasites attracted the attention of Meng and his men. They saw the parasites who had completely lost the aura of the evil god, and thought that these people were civilians who came from the territory.

They didn't feel like it. After finding out the truth, they were all surprised and ran to find Wu Qing immediately.

Meng shouted to the Zerg puppy beside him, and the puppy took them to find Wu Qing.

"Wu Qing! What's going on? What did you do to those evil god believers?"

Seeing Wu Qing from a distance, Meng shouted, he was really curious.

Being able to save the evil god believers again is of great significance to the native camp of this world!

Wu Qing knew Meng's idea, but it was a pity that the evil god believers could be changed to another camp through parasitism, but they could not be restored to their original state. This was not a real rescue.

Perhaps when the Zerg unlocks more technology in the future, or when the interstellar Protoss is born, it will be possible to truly save these believers who have been controlled by the evil god.

"Meng, don't get excited first. I changed their camps through the Zerg technology, but I didn't really save them."

"They are no longer the same as before!"

Wu Qing did not hide it and told Meng and others that he could not save the evil god believers.

"In the past, when we encountered these evil god believers, we just killed them with one blow!"

"It's not bad now. We can change the camp of the evil god believers and use them for our own benefit. This is a win-win situation, haha!"

Meng was not too disappointed when he learned the reason. He knew that the evil god used a very terrifying mental control to transform intelligent creatures into believers. He had never heard of anyone who could recover intact.

"I was just worrying about the transportation of materials in this city. Now it's good. With such a professional transportation team, it's much more convenient!"

Meng didn't expect the Zerg to seize so many materials. With these materials, many things don't need to be purchased by the caravan at a cost of luck.

"Meng, you contact the various territories of the alliance through the host and let everyone arrange personnel to help with the transportation."

"The Zerg will be responsible for the safety of the road. After the war, we will distribute the materials according to the merits."

Wu Qing will not take these materials for himself. The alliance territories that participated in the war and contributed will get some benefits. No matter how much they get, they need to do this.

With such a model in the past, the alliance will have a good precedent to follow in the future, so that the alliance can develop better and attract more territories to join.

"Okay! Let's arrange it now!"

Meng responded, and went with Yu Chong and Bai Yan to arrange for the alliance territories to help transport supplies.

The total population of the alliance's territories is still considerable. As long as they are mobilized, the transportation speed of supplies will be greatly accelerated.

The Zerg territory began to continue to increase the number of puppies. A large number of puppies were sent to the wild, running around and lurking. Wu Qing wanted to control several key areas around and the routes around the transportation team.

As long as the signs of danger are found, the Zerg troops on standby will go to eliminate the danger.

...

Daxia Territory is the destination of this material transportation.

Last night, Wu Qing was preparing for today's material transportation. In the underground space of the new city of Daxia Territory, the queen of insects commanded a large number of worker bees to dig an underground warehouse overnight.

Daxia Territory has not even built houses yet, and there is no place to store supplies. It is not appropriate to store these supplies in the open air or in other territories.

Wu Qing thought about it and decided that the underground space in Daxia Territory's new city was the best choice.

It is safe and hidden enough, and the space is large enough.

In Daxia Territory's new city, early in the morning, the worker bees built a wide road extending from the core area of the city to the avenue outside the territory, and cleared a huge open space in the new city for temporary loading and unloading of supplies.

The other side had just left the city, and this side was already ready.

Today, all the worker bees stopped their work, lined up to leave the territory, and went to transport supplies.

Wu Qing felt that the transportation force was not enough, so he decided to increase the number of worker bees by one thousand, bringing the number of Zerg worker bees to two thousand.

The huge hosts have not yet evolved abdominal sacs, so they can't transport supplies properly, but this is the real world, and their strong, powerful and flexible tentacles can carry a large amount of supplies.

Therefore, except for a few hosts left in the Great Xia Territory, the rest of the Zerg territory served as porters.

On the way from Daxia Territory to the material storage city, more and more teams came. Nearly two thousand Zerg worker bees worked while rushing along the way, using their super excavation and transportation capabilities to quickly build a simple road.

The various territories of the alliance also received the news and sent a large number of personnel and vehicles to join this transportation road.

It was not until noon that this transportation road was completely smooth.

The continuous transportation of materials to Daxia Territory shocked the people of Daxia Territory who were busy building the city and didn't know what was going on. They were speechless.

Many of the refugees whose freedom was restricted had various speculations in their hearts when they saw such a scene.

The two thousand human wanderers who were also arranged to camp in Daxia Territory knew that the evil god camp might have suffered a defeat at the hands of the Zerg this time, and their evaluation of the Zerg was several levels higher.

Due to the powerful control power of the Zerg Zergling, the scouts of the Tengu tribe could not enter the area blocked by the Zerg. The transportation of materials here was in full swing for a long time, but the Tengu tribe on the other side still knew nothing.

The main focus of the Tengu tribe was still on clearing the battlefield, and the secondary focus was on strengthening the control of the military camps and garrison territories of the evil god camp.

With the tone set by the tribe elder Gou Hong, no one has taken the initiative to cause trouble for the Zerg for the time being, and the two sides are now in a state of non-interference.
